bothHint: Two languages at once: a little slower, best kept for documents that mix French and English.
skipText: Skip pages that already contain text
skipTextHint: They are already searchable: no need to read them again.
exportTextHint: A .txt file comes with the PDF.
downloadHint: First use: about {{size}} to download (recognition engine and language model), once only. OCR then works offline.
speedHint: Expect several seconds per page, more on a phone. Progress is shown page by page and you can cancel at any time.
limits: Handwriting, skewed or poor-quality scans give uncertain results.
willSkip_one: {{count}} page skipped: it already contains text.
willSkip_other: {{count}} pages skipped: they already contain text.
untouched: Pages keep exactly the same look: invisible text is simply laid on top, for searching, selecting and copying.
summary_other: {{count}} pages to recognise, one after the other.
nothing: Every chosen page already contains text: there is nothing to recognise. Turn the option off to read them anyway.
loadFailed: The recognition engine could not be loaded. On first use it has to be downloaded: check your connection, then try again.
noText: No text was recognised in these pages. They may be blank, handwritten, or in another language: no file was produced.
noteLow: Check the result: recognition may have made mistakes.
